paragraphs: Last Saturday, my friends and I visited a gaming café {{mask_1}} has old and new games on the same shelves. The first room {{mask_2}} we played was full of racing games. The shop owner showed us a game booth {{mask_3}} the newest co-op titles were on display. We also found a corner {{mask_4}} the controllers were cheaper than usual. The best part was a stage {{mask_5}} local teams played live matches every evening.

A manager told us about a special event {{mask_6}} many players were invited to test a new strategy game. The room {{mask_7}} this event happened was crowded with fans. The guide explained that the cafe is a place {{mask_8}} players can relax after school. We liked the gaming lounge {{mask_9}} the sound was softer, because it was easier to talk there.
